title: Quasi-steady storage-flux manifold hydrological discriminator
purpose: Test whether a physics-derived quasi-steady vertical profile manifold can recover the lower-zone storage/groundwater-flux relationship that defeated L2_IMC, before any lookup-table approximation or performance engineering.

predecessor_evidence.D4: R8/R4/R2 form an admitted coarse-Richards development fidelity sequence but have weak lower-boundary event fidelity and high reattempt fractions.
predecessor_evidence.D5: L2_IMC is stable and mass-conservative but dominated by R2; its pooled upper-storage error is tiny while lower-storage/bottom-flux error dominates.
predecessor_evidence.implication: D6 changes the lower-zone closure architecture rather than retuning D5.

literature_precedent.MetaSWAP: Storage/flux manifolds built from physically resolved unsaturated-zone profiles are precedent for purpose-dependent reduced modeling; no MetaSWAP implementation or calibration table is reused.
literature_precedent.two_layer_integrated: He et al. 2021/2022 are precedent for layer-integrated conservation and groundwater coupling; D6 is not their two-layer ODE.
literature_precedent.inheritance_boundary: D6 is a clean-sheet steady-profile manifold defined entirely below.

candidate.profile_state: not dynamically stored; reconstructed from a steady B01 vertical profile manifold at each stage

steady_profile_equations.coordinate: x positive downward from surface; auxiliary y=160-x positive upward from bottom
steady_profile_equations.constitutive: same analytic B01 Van Genuchten/Mualem equations as D5

manifold_evaluation.numerical_integration: fixed-step classical RK4 on the steady-profile ODE

prescribed_bottom_head.residual: integrated profile storage - requested dynamic storage

prescribed_bottom_flux.residual: integrated profile storage - requested dynamic storage

manifold_evaluation.root_requirement: bracket endpoints must be finite and have opposite residual signs or one exact zero; otherwise fail closed
manifold_evaluation.physical_profile_requirement: all evaluated h finite and negative; all theta strictly between theta_r and theta_s; all K finite and positive

dynamic_update.method: single scalar Heun predictor-corrector per 0.0008-day interval
dynamic_update.q_top_mapping: same native-to-downward-positive mapping frozen in D5
dynamic_update.upper_lower_storage: integrals of the terminal quasi-steady profile over 0-80 and 80-160 cm

seed.seed_rule: apply the same scalar Heun update for two seed intervals; exact equilibrium should not drift beyond roundoff

computational_boundary.next_if_hydrologically_positive: Only then preregister offline tabulation/interpolation and same-runtime cost qualification.
computational_boundary.rationale: Use a deliberately accurate manifold evaluator first so hydrological architecture error is not confounded with table discretization.

integrity_kill: profile pressure head reaches or exceeds zero or leaves finite constitutive domain
dynamic storage outside open physical bounds
any clipping, adaptive dynamic substep or full-order fallback
positive_rule: and QS1 improves on R2 on at least one preregistered fidelity view
balance view: total-storage RMSE and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE both <= R2
or transient view: terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 and sign-error count <= R2

purpose_dependent_boundary.LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE: D6 can establish architecture candidacy only, not acceptance.
purpose_dependent_boundary.GROUNDWATER_COUPLED_MANY_COLUMN: May remain candidate only if bottom-flux behavior improves; actual coupling qualification remains separate.

successor_logic.if_positive: Preregister a tabulated QS1 manifold with interpolation error controls, then place it on an actual cost-fidelity frontier against R8/R4/R2/RossFast/current Reference.
successor_logic.if_negative: Close one-state quasi-steady manifold. The remaining reduced-model direction requires explicit dynamic profile memory/state, not further tuning of QS1.
successor_logic.if_integrity_fails: Close QS1 without widening brackets or changing integration after exposure.
